__1 The sacred syllable om, uttered as a holy exclamation at the beginning and end of a reading of the Vedas, or previous to the commencement of a prayer or sacred work. 
__2 As a particle it implies 
___(a) solemn affirmation and respectful assent (so be it, amen!); 
___(b) assent or acceptance (yes, all right); ओमित्युच्यताममात्यः [[
